location_and_callers.capture: Frontend boundary events and resulting state; source inspected. Internal children not individually intercepted.

upstream_stage: Domain solver and actual initial state
downstream_stage: Actual renderer at t=0 over the original

actual_input.capture_note: Exact available recorded inputs. File/DOM/library objects may be represented as opaque metadata; raw byte/array references remain authoritative.

expected_input: Native source coordinates, source dimensions, viewport dimensions, DPR and image rectangle.

actual_output.capture_note: Return values are retained unchanged. captureError for JSON.stringify(undefined) is a recorder serialization limitation, not an application exception. Use observed resulting state for void methods.

expected_output_contract: Invertible mapping with the same image/overlay scale and offsets. Applying viewToSource(sourceToView(p)) should recover the supplied point within floating-point precision.
expected_diagram: 60° is printed apex-angle evidence. Vertices and rays require source measurement. No numerical refractive index is printed. An assumed index must not be described as measured from this diagram.
finding: Actual sourceToView/sourceToOverlay and inverse results preserve supplied points. This does not validate the input coordinates against the source.
change_or_loss: sourceToView includes viewport letterboxing; sourceToOverlay omits it because the overlay is already image-aligned. Browser coordinates add the measured image origin. Do not add letterboxing twice.
